evidence.observation: Exhaust O2 has stayed at about 4-7 ppm since the purge ended, so the atmosphere is inert.
The thermocouple is holding 750.0 °C. It overshot to 760 °C briefly at the start of growth, which is a normal settling transient.
Heater power is steady at about 46% for holding temperature, which matches the thermocouple reading.
Argon flow is at 100 sccm, matching the setpoint.
Pressure is steady at about 3.1 Torr, matching the flow, so there is no sign of a leak or blockage.

args.missing_evidence: The sample has not been characterized yet (e.g. Raman or optical inspection after the run), so there is no answer yet on whether the target material grew.
